metadata.question: Does the water storage in Alabama decreases from 2003 to 2012?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to use GRACE data for water storage analysis - Collection: "NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/LAND" or similar - Date: 2003 and 2012 (need to specify time periods) - Location: Alabama state boundary 2. Masking strategy: - GRACE data typically doesn't need cloud masking - May need to filter for data quality flags - Need to extract liquid water equivalent thickness 3. Logic: - Compare mean water storage in 2003 vs 2012 - Valid result: If 2012 < 2003, answer is "A" (Yes, it decreased) - If 2012 >= 2003, answer is "B" (No, it didn't decrease) - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const alabama = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Alabama')) .geometry(); const date2003Start = '2003-01-01'; const date2003End = '2003-12-31'; const date2012Start = '2012-01-01'; const date2012End = '2012-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const grace = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/LAND'); const col2003 = grace.filterDate(date2003Start, date2003End) .filterBounds(alabama); const col2012 = grace.filterDate(date2012Start, date2012End) .filterBounds(alabama); const size2003 = col2003.size().getInfo(); const size2012 = col2012.size().getInfo(); console.log('2003 Images:', size2003); console.log('2012 Images:', size2012); if (size2003 === 0 || size2012 === 0) { console.log('No data available for one or both years.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean water storage const mean2003 = col2003.select('lwe_thickness_csr').mean(); const mean2012 = col2012.select('lwe_thickness_csr').mean(); // Check pixel counts const count2003 = mean2003.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: alabama, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('lwe_thickness_csr').getInfo(); const count2012 = mean2012.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: alabama, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('lwe_thickness_csr').getInfo(); console.log('2003 Valid Pixels:', count2003); console.log('2012 Valid Pixels:', count2012); if (count2003 === 0 || count2012 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculation const val2003 = mean2003.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: alabama, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('lwe_thickness_csr').getInfo(); const val2012 = mean2012.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: alabama, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('lwe_thickness_csr').getInfo(); console.log('2003 Mean Water Storage (cm):', val2003 !== null ? val2003.toFixed(2) : 'null'); console.log('2012 Mean Water Storage (cm):', val2012 !== null ? val2012.toFixed(2) : 'null'); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (val2003 === null || val2012 === null || isNaN(val2003) || isNaN(val2012)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const change = val2012 - val2003; console.log('Change (2012-2003):', change.toFixed(2), 'cm'); if (val2012 < val2003) { console.log('Water storage decreased from 2003 to 2012.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Water storage did not decrease from 2003 to 2012.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
